I added a small **PARTNEŘI AKCE** line just above the yellow edge and the green bottom bar on the IG event post (`ig-event-square`).

**What changed** (`ui/2026/combine/Combine-kampan.tsx:722`)
- **The new line:** set in the same small mono style as the KDY/KDE labels, in grey, aligned to the left margin.
- **The block above it:** there was no free space there. The headline-and-info block already ran down to the bottom bar, so the new line first landed on top of the date. To make room I:
  - shrank the "STOPKY / NELŽOU" headline from 112 to 96 px,
  - tightened the gaps inside the block,
  - moved the block up 14 px.
- **Result:** the block now ends at about 1160 px. The partner line sits at 1190–1214 px, and the yellow edge starts at 1222 px. Nothing overlaps. Before this change the bottom info lines also overlapped the yellow edge; that's fixed too.

**How I checked it:** I measured element positions in the rendered canvas, before and after. The screenshot tool only gives a thumbnail-size picture of the artboard, so I couldn't check it by eye. Please look at it in the studio.

**What I left alone**
- **Only the label, no partner names or logos:** you didn't say which partners to list and I didn't want to invent any. The canvas already imports `SponsorBar` / `SPONSOR_LOGOS` if you want logos on this line.
- **The canvas check fails on an older problem:** `Combine-kampan.tsx:1270` has an artboard id written as an expression instead of a plain string. My change didn't cause it, so I didn't touch it.
